text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, looks like I got a bit
too focused on fighting~...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well, I tried out the instant-sleep spell
my Papa taught me, you see...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
When you can't sleep, just picture wrestlers
challenging you one after another in your head, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Papa said that 'by defeating challengers, you can enter the dream world,' but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, that wrestler who jumped in out of nowhere~...
I was so close to winning, too~~... *yawn*
